body:
## AF — Developmental capability space, information provenance, and barrier-displacement programme

This addendum follows the #833 AE information/structure programme and the #233 HSG foundation. It is **not** a claim that the classical barriers have been disproved. It turns the barrier question into a first-class GMI research object: identify the exact assumptions under which a boundary holds, determine the smallest principled changes in substrate/information/task/output/resource conditions that move the boundary, charge those changes explicitly, and preserve the residual boundary.

No checkbox below is scientifically closed by this comment.

### AF0 — Parent subtraction / non-renaming gate

The programme must import rather than rename strongest parents. In particular:

- #233/HSG already owns or imports decision-sufficiency/Blackwell-Le Cam integration, information-processing ceilings, the closed-computable no-ex-nihilo novelty bound, Blum-speedup cautions, and the anti-finality/RGC principle. These are parents here, not new GMI discoveries.
- #833 AE already owns the open tasks on task-relevant structure, Information Bottleneck/rate-distortion, prediction-vs-control, usable information, causal/interventional distinctions, CPC comparison, and world-model necessity/non-necessity.
- Classical parents to pin explicitly include Turing/Church computability and relative computability, Rice, Gödel incompleteness at its exact formal scope, Blum speedup, Wolpert-Macready NFL and sharpened permutation-closure forms, Blackwell/Le Cam comparison of experiments, information bottleneck/rate-distortion, abstract interpretation, certificate/proof-carrying verification, property testing, identification-in-the-limit/list identification, bounded optimality/metareasoning, algorithmic information/logical depth, and open-ended evolution.

Research anchors for the first freeze include:

- SEP, recursive functions / relative computability / Turing jump: https://plato.stanford.edu/entries/recursive-functions/
- SEP, Church-Turing thesis and physical variants: https://plato.stanford.edu/entries/church-turing/
- Rice theorem / generalized abstract-semantics result: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.ic.2022.104953
- sharpened NFL review: https://arxiv.org/abs/cs/0303032
- abstract interpretation as sound approximation of undecidable semantics: https://www.di.ens.fr/~cousot/COUSOTpapers/CSL-LICS14.shtml
- Goldreich, property testing / approximate decisions: https://www.wisdom.weizmann.ac.il/~oded/pt-intro.html
- Charikar-Pabbaraju-Tewari 2026 list language identification: https://proceedings.mlr.press/v336/charikar26a.html
- Siegelmann-Sontag analog computation and nonuniform power: https://doi.org/10.1016/0304-3975(94)90178-3

- [x] Pin the exact #233/HSG theorem/manifest versions imported by AF and fail closed on drift. — ✅ `gmi-833-af-barrier-context-v1` six #233/HST/HSG parents are pinned by Git blob SHA plus the HSG-T51 authority pinned to #233 comment 5609406015 (updated_at 2026-09-09T22:07:34Z, exact heading); fail-closed verified by mutating one pin to 40 zeroes, which aborts `af_barrier_context_v1.py` with `ValueError: parent pin drift`, while the unmutated run exits 0 (`parent_pin_count=6`).
- [x] Build `GMI_BARRIER_PARENT_LEDGER` with theorem, exact assumptions, conclusion, known relaxations, strongest source, and GMI residual. — ✅ `gmi-833-af-barrier-context-v1` `GMI_BARRIER_PARENT_LEDGER_V1` holds 21 parent rows, each carrying exactly the six required fields `theorem_or_result`, `assumptions`, `conclusion`, `relaxations`, `strongest_source` and `af_residual` (parent_census=21).
- [x] Separate mathematical Church-Turing/effective-computation claims from empirical physical-computation theses. — ✅ `gmi-833-af-barrier-context-v1` FORMALIZATION_V1 section 1 splits the two families explicitly (mathematical effective-computation claims vs empirical physical-computation theses) and the ledger row `EFFECTIVE_VS_PHYSICAL_CT_BOUNDARY` carries residual 'AF0 records PHYSICAL_STATUS_UNKNOWN unless operational physical evidence exists', with `PHYSICAL_STATUS_UNKNOWN` in the AF3 status vocabulary.
- [x] Prohibit `BROKE_<THEOREM>` wording unless the original premises are literally retained and a valid contradiction is independently verified; otherwise use barrier displacement/relativization/contract change terminology. — ✅ `gmi-833-af-barrier-context-v1` AF-T03 admits `BROKE_*` only under five conjunctive conditions (premises retained, same problem contract, same output contract, independently verified contradiction witness, class LITERAL_CONTRADICTION); the hostile relabelling the finite-promise restriction as BROKE_TURING is rejected (`broke_changed_premise_hostile_rejected=true`) and BROKE_TURING/RICE/GODEL/NFL/BLUM sit in `forbidden_promotions`.

---

### AF1 — Developmental capability response object

Data must not define the existence of the machine-intelligence possibility space. Let a registered computational/physical substrate be `S`, initial organization `M0`, developmental law `Delta`, information-provenance channels `Pi`, task/specification family `Q`, resource vector `R`, interaction horizon/protocol `H`, and verifier/output contract `V`.

Define a set-valued developmental capability object schematically as

```text
Gamma_{M0,Delta}^S(Pi,R,H,Q,V)
  = reachable capability/resource profiles under the registered conditions.
```

Raw capability/resource vectors and Pareto frontiers remain primary; no universal scalar intelligence score is presumed.

- [x] Formalize `Gamma` architecture-neutrally and prove its relation to existing #833 capability, reachability, morphology and resource objects. — ✅ `gmi-833-af-barrier-context-v1` `Gamma^S_{M0,Delta}(Pi,R,H,Q,V)` is defined as a set of profiles `(c,r,pi,m,h)` with no architecture name and no scalar intelligence score, and section 2.1 states its relation to each existing object: capability (consumes the #833 external contract), reachability (profile-valued lift), morphology (property of terminal realization m, not a primitive), resources (raw vectors primary), HST/HSG.
- [x] Define current realized capability as a zero-development/registered-current-state slice rather than equating it with developmental potential. — ✅ `gmi-833-af-barrier-context-v1` `Current(M0,Q,V) = { c(g) : g in Gamma and development_steps(g)=0 }` is the zero-development slice, and microscope F1 shows it under-determines Gamma: both systems score current `1/2` on identity while one reaches capability set {1, 1/2} and the frozen one stays {1/2}.
- [x] Define information/data-independent *possibility space* `M(S)` separately from history-conditioned reachable machines. — ✅ `gmi-833-af-barrier-context-v1` `M(S)` is defined as the data/history-independent admitted class and `Reach(M0,Delta,Pi,R,H,V) subseteq M(S)` separately; the exact witness is `NOT` in `M(S)\Reach` with `possibility_set=[C0,C1,ID,NOT]` against `frozen_reachable_set=[C0]`, independently reconstructed by `independent_oracle_v1.py` (`possibility_vs_reachability: true`).
- [x] Define provenance-tagged development channels at least for: initial/inherited organization; external observations; rewards/evaluator feedback; endogenous computation; stochastic variation; oracle/advice/tool channels; other-agent/social/cultural transfer; physical/environmental signals. — ✅ `gmi-833-af-barrier-context-v1` all eight required channels are registered verbatim as `provenance_tags`: INITIAL_OR_INHERITED_ORGANIZATION, EXTERNAL_OBSERVATION, REWARD_OR_EVALUATOR_SIGNAL, ENDOGENOUS_COMPUTE, STOCHASTIC_VARIATION, ORACLE_ADVICE_OR_TOOL, SOCIAL_OR_CULTURAL_TRANSFER, PHYSICAL_OR_ENVIRONMENTAL_SIGNAL.
- [x] Define capability acquisition provenance so an apparent gain cannot be called `emergent from nothing` when information was imported through initialization, arbitrary real constants, an oracle, evaluator feedback, another agent, or a physical measurement channel. — ✅ `gmi-833-af-barrier-context-v1` section 2.4 fixes 'a path cannot omit a consumed channel' and rules that an arbitrary real parameter used as nonuniform advice 'is never free emergence from nothing'; the exact instances are F5 (`IMPORTED_ORACLE_OR_ADVICE_POWER`, 1 bit target MI) and F5b target-correlated initialization (`IMPORTED_INFORMATION_OR_ADVICE`, provenance INITIAL_OR_INHERITED_ORGANIZATION).
- [x] Construct exact finite `G0` microscopes where two machines have the same current capability but different `Gamma`, and conversely.
- [ ] Replace/upgrade #833-L's single row `developmental potential separately from current capability` with this response-object view after theorem closure, not before.

---

### AF2 — Null-experience developmental envelope

Define the null-external slice by setting registered external observation/reward/task-feedback channels to null while keeping the substrate, initial organization and explicitly allowed endogenous processes visible:

```text
Gamma_null(M0,Delta;R,H,Q,V)
 = Gamma(Pi_external = 0, ...).
```

`NO_EXTERNAL_DATA` is therefore not synonymous with `NOTHING`.

- [x] Define a hierarchy of null conditions: no sensory observations; no reward/evaluator feedback; no task-specific data; no external interaction; no endogenous randomness; no task-specific initialization; absolute registered null except substrate/dynamics. — ✅ `gmi-833-af-barrier-context-v1` the receipt carries all seven named null conditions in order with their exact forbidden-channel sets: NO_SENSORY_OBSERVATIONS, NO_REWARD_OR_EVALUATOR_FEEDBACK, NO_TASK_SPECIFIC_DATA, NO_EXTERNAL_INTERACTION, NO_ENDOGENOUS_RANDOMNESS, NO_TASK_SPECIFIC_INITIALIZATION, ABSOLUTE_REGISTERED_NULL_EXCEPT_SUBSTRATE_AND_DYNAMICS (`null_condition_count: 7` in the independent oracle).
- [x] Prove a **Null Target-Information Acquisition** specialization of the data-processing inequality: if target `Theta` is independent of `(M0,W)` and no `Theta`-dependent channel enters development, then for `Mt=f(M0,W)` the machine cannot acquire target information, e.g. `I(Theta;Mt)=0` at the registered probabilistic scope. — ✅ `gmi-833-af-barrier-context-v1` AF-T01 states and proves exactly the asked specialization - Theta independent of Z=(M0,W), Mt=f(Z) deterministic, Markov chain Theta->Z->Mt, data-processing inequality gives I(Theta;Mt)<=I(Theta;Z)=0 - with receipt `finite_joint_mutual_information_bits: 0.0` reproduced independently by `independent_oracle_v1.py` (`independent_target_mi_bits: 0.0`).
- [x] Parent-subtract HSG's algorithmic-information no-ex-nihilo result rather than re-claim it; distinguish Shannon target-information from Kolmogorov-description statements. — ✅ `gmi-833-af-barrier-context-v1` section 3.3 restates HSG-T51 as the parent bound K(s_n)<=K(F)+K(s_0)+K(n)+O(1) and explicitly separates it from the Shannon statement ('That parent is about description length/Kolmogorov complexity. AF-T01 is about mutual information with a registered random target'), with ownership pinned to #233 comment 5609406015 and verified live by `verify_hsg_parent_authority_v1.py` (exit 0).
- [x] Construct exact examples where accessible capability increases with zero external data through deduction/search/compilation/caching/self-simulation, while no independent target information is acquired. — ✅ `gmi-833-af-barrier-context-v1` control F3 is exactly such an example: with zero external data, deterministic internal compute moves accuracy from `1/2` to `1` while registered target information stays `1 bit -> 1 bit`, terminal `COMPUTATIONAL_UNFOLDING_WITHOUT_EXTERNAL_DATA`.
- [x] Separate `information acquisition` from `computational unfolding/accessibility` and from `random novelty generation`. — ✅ `gmi-833-af-barrier-context-v1` the three are machine-separated by distinct terminals with distinct numbers: unfolding (accuracy 1/2->1, target info 1->1 bit), random novelty (output entropy 1.0 bit, target MI 0.0 bit, accuracy 1/2), acquisition (oracle target MI 1.0 bit).
- [x] Build hostile: random bits independent of target can generate new candidates/complexity but cannot create target alignment without a correlated selection/evaluation channel. — ✅ `gmi-833-af-barrier-context-v1` hostile F4 supplies an independent fair random bit: `output_entropy_bits: 1.0` but `target_mutual_information_bits: 0.0` and `expected_target_accuracy: 1/2`, terminal `RANDOM_NOVELTY_WITHOUT_TARGET_ALIGNMENT`.
- [x] Build hostile: a purported zero-data super-capability encoded in an oracle/advice string/arbitrary real parameter must be classified `IMPORTED_INFORMATION_OR_ADVICE`, not spontaneous intelligence. — ✅ `gmi-833-af-barrier-context-v1` hostiles F5 and F5b do exactly this: a target-correlated oracle bit yields `target_mutual_information_bits: 1.0` and accuracy `1` but only under `ORACLE_ADVICE_OR_TOOL` provenance (`IMPORTED_ORACLE_OR_ADVICE_POWER`), and arbitrary-real/advice content in the initial organization is classified `IMPORTED_INFORMATION_OR_ADVICE`.
- [x] Introduce scoped terminals such as `NO_TARGET_INFORMATION_ACQUIRED`, `COMPUTATIONAL_UNFOLDING_WITHOUT_EXTERNAL_DATA`, `RANDOM_NOVELTY_WITHOUT_TARGET_ALIGNMENT`, `IMPORTED_ORACLE_OR_ADVICE_POWER`, and `UNEXERCISED_CAPABILITY` distinct from `INCAPABLE`. — ✅ `gmi-833-af-barrier-context-v1` `af2.terminals` registers all five asked terminals plus IMPORTED_INFORMATION_OR_ADVICE, and FORMALIZATION 3.4 states that neither NO_TARGET_INFORMATION_ACQUIRED nor UNEXERCISED_CAPABILITY is synonymous with INCAPABLE.

---

### AF3 — Barrier context and barrier surfaces

A barrier statement must be relative to an explicit context rather than treated as one undifferentiated wall. Register a barrier context such as

```text
chi = (S, Pi, Q, R, H, eps, delta, V)
```

where `S` is substrate semantics, `Pi` information provenance, `Q` problem/query class, `R` resources, `H` horizon/interaction protocol, `(eps,delta)` approximation/confidence parameters, and `V` output/verifier contract.

Define typed status, not a single solvable/unsolvable bit, e.g.

```text
DECIDABLE
SEMI_DECIDABLE
CERTIFIABLE
SOUND_INCOMPLETE_APPROXIMATION
PROBABILISTIC_APPROXIMATION
IDENTIFIABLE_IN_LIMIT
NOT_IDENTIFIABLE_AT_SCOPE
UNDECIDABLE_RELATIVE_TO_S
RESOURCE_INFEASIBLE_AT_SCOPE
PHYSICAL_STATUS_UNKNOWN
```

A **barrier surface** is a region/boundary in `chi` where this status or attainable capability changes.

- [x] Formalize barrier context, typed status and exact transition/displacement semantics. — ✅ `gmi-833-af-barrier-context-v1` barrier context is `chi=(S,Pi,Q,R,H,eps,delta,V)`, the typed status vocabulary has 10 registered values (DECIDABLE ... PHYSICAL_STATUS_UNKNOWN) and displacement semantics are instantiated by four full transition records, independently counted by the oracle (`f7_record_count: 4`).
- [x] Require every claimed barrier displacement to state which premise/axis changed and the exact information/resource/substrate power added or requirement weakened. — ✅ `gmi-833-af-barrier-context-v1` every transition record carries `changed_axes`, `original_premises`, `retained_premises` and `extra_power_or_weakened_requirement` - e.g. F7_ORACLE_RELATIVIZATION changes axes [S,Pi,R] and records 'add an explicitly charged oracle channel deciding the base halting set'.
- [x] Distinguish theorem contradiction, domain restriction, promise problem, approximation, semidecision, abstention, list output, certificate/witness, interaction/query access, oracle/advice, randomness, resource relaxation and substrate expansion. — ✅ `gmi-833-af-barrier-context-v1` the frozen transition classes are exactly the thirteen asked: domain restriction, promise problem, approximation, semidecision, abstention, list/set output, certificate, interaction/query, oracle/advice, randomness, resource relaxation, substrate expansion and literal contradiction.
- [x] Prove monotonicity only where added channels/resources are optional and the old strategy remains admissible; add mandatory-overhead/interference counterexamples. — ✅ `gmi-833-af-barrier-context-v1` AF-T02 proves monotonicity only under optionality + zero mandatory overhead + preserved order; hostile F6 is the counterexample: base net 8, optional strategy leaves optimum at 8, and a mandatory overhead of 12 reverses best net to -4 (`reversal: true`), independently reconstructed by the oracle as `mandatory_overhead_reversal: [8, 8, -4]`.
- [x] Require nearest residual barrier after every successful displacement; no `SOLVED_FOREVER` terminal. — ✅ `gmi-833-af-barrier-context-v1` all four transition records carry a non-empty `nearest_residual_barrier` and `solved_forever_allowed: false`, with SOLVED_FOREVER in `forbidden_promotions`.

---

### AF4 — Relative computability and the non-terminal frontier

The computability lane should test barrier displacement rather than merely recite halting/Rice/Gödel ceilings.

For an oracle/substrate `A`, the relativized halting set/Turing jump `A'` can decide questions not computable in `A`, but classical computability theory gives

```text
A <_T A'.
```

Thus a stronger oracle can genuinely displace a weaker system's halting boundary while generating a new relative boundary above it.

- [x] Import/prove-at-parent-scope the exact relative-computability/Turing-jump statements needed by GMI; do not rename them. — ✅ `gmi-833-af4-relative-computability-v1` `PARENT_LEDGER_V1.json` row `AF4-P1-TURING-JUMP` imports the jump theorem at its own assumptions (`A'` is c.e. in `A` but not computable in `A`, hence `deg_T(A) < deg_T(A')`) citing SEP *Recursive Functions* Prop. 3.7, and `RESULT_V1.json#parent_theorem.ownership` is `PARENT_OWNED_NOT_PROVED_BY_EXECUTOR` with `evidence_role: REGISTRY_COROLLARY_AND_HOSTILE_VALIDATION_NOT_PARENT_THEOREM_PROOF`, so nothing is renamed as a GMI discovery.
- [x] Formalize `Comp(S)` / computational power of substrate `S` as a registered object, with oracle/advice channels explicit. — ✅ `gmi-833-af4-relative-computability-v1` `comp_object: "Comp(S[A]) := deg_T(A) at registered standard-oracle scope only"` over the registered substrate `S[A]=(ORACLE_TM, oracle=A, access_contract, provenance, raw_resource_contract)`; all 7 `jump_chain` levels carry `provenance: ORACLE_ADVICE_OR_TOOL`, `access_charge_per_query: 1` and `finite_advice_bits: null`.
- [x] Derive the scoped GMI consequence `NO_TERMINAL_EFFECTIVE_FRONTIER_AT_REGISTERED_ORACLE_MODEL_SCOPE`: for the standard Turing-jump hierarchy, every fixed oracle degree has a strictly stronger jump. — ✅ `gmi-833-af4-relative-computability-v1` `nonterminal_frontier_terminal: NO_TERMINAL_EFFECTIVE_FRONTIER_AT_REGISTERED_ORACLE_MODEL_SCOPE` at `scope: standard oracle Turing model; finite registered jump levels 0..6`, every `jump_chain` entry recording `parent_relation_to_next: STRICTLY_BELOW_BY_TURING_JUMP_PARENT`.
- [x] Distinguish that result from a universal metaphysical claim about all possible physics. — ✅ `gmi-833-af4-relative-computability-v1` `physical_scope: NO_PHYSICAL_HYPERCOMPUTATION_CLAIM` and `forbidden_promotions` carries `NO_FINAL_COMPUTABILITY_BARRIER_IN_ALL_PHYSICS`, `PHYSICAL_CHURCH_TURING_FALSIFIED` and `PHYSICAL_HYPERCOMPUTATION_ESTABLISHED`; tests 08 and 15 enforce it, 16/16 passing when re-run on laptop-billy at main `349c2e62`.
- [x] Show how the machine-intelligence capability envelope changes under `S -> S+oracle`, charging oracle/advice information and access cost. — ✅ `gmi-833-af4-relative-computability-v1` 6 `adjacent_displacements` records, each `S_n -> S_(n+1)` with `changed_axes: [S, Pi, R]`, `direct_oracle_queries: 1`, `oracle_access_charge: 1`, `provenance: ORACLE_ADVICE_OR_TOOL`, `Q_n` moving `UNDECIDABLE_RELATIVE_TO_S -> DECIDABLE` and `nearest_residual` preserved; `ORACLE_POWER_FREE` is a forbidden promotion and `finite_advice_bits` is `null` by construction because an infinite oracle is not assigned a fabricated finite bit count (test 06).
- [x] Build hostile against `HALTING_PROBLEM_SOLVED_UNIVERSALLY`: solving the ordinary halting problem using an oracle does not decide the oracle-relative halting problem. — ✅ `gmi-833-af4-relative-computability-v1` `base_halting_hostile` records `S0_Q0: UNDECIDABLE_RELATIVE_TO_S`, `S1_Q0: DECIDABLE_BY_ONE_IMPORTED_ORACLE_QUERY`, `S1_Q1: UNDECIDABLE_RELATIVE_TO_S`, `residual_preserved: true` and `universal_terminal_allowed: false`, with `HALTING_PROBLEM_SOLVED_UNIVERSALLY` in `forbidden_promotions` and test 02 rejecting the promotion.
- [x] Re-audit Gödel-machine/self-referential claims: provability-relative self-improvement is not escape from incompleteness; the proof system/axioms remain part of `S/Pi`. — ✅ `gmi-833-af4-relative-computability-v1` `godel_machine_audit` demands the full `ProofContext` (formal_system_id, axioms_id, proof_rules_id, utility_theorem, consistency/soundness assumptions, proof_search_contract) and returns `changed_axioms_reading: PROOF_SYSTEM_CONTEXT_CHANGED_NOT_INCOMPLETENESS_ESCAPE`, `unprovable_reading: NOT_DERIVABLE_IN_REGISTERED_T__TRUTH_NOT_INFERRED`, `registered_reading: PROOF_SYSTEM_RELATIVE_SELF_IMPROVEMENT_CLAIM_ONLY`, with `GODEL_INCOMPLETENESS_ESCAPED` and `GODEL_MACHINE_PROVES_UNIVERSAL_SELF_IMPROVEMENT` forbidden and the Schmidhuber parent (arXiv:cs/0309048) pinned as conditional on its provability assumptions.

---

### AF5 — Verification barrier displacement

Rice/halting prevent a complete universal terminating semantic classifier at the usual unrestricted scope, but practical verification has multiple legitimate contract changes.

- [x] State the exact unrestricted semantic-verification no-go and its assumptions. — ✅ `gmi-833-af5-verification-barriers-v1` `parent_no_go.reading` states it with its assumptions attached — "no automatic terminating correct decider for every nontrivial unrestricted semantic program property at the classical parent scope" — under `ownership: PARENT_OWNED_NOT_PROVED_BY_EXECUTOR`, with `RICE_THEOREM_FALSE` and `UNRESTRICTED_SEMANTIC_VERIFICATION_SOLVED` in `forbidden_promotions`.
- [x] Build a verification-status lattice covering decidable restricted fragments, semi-decision, proof/certificate checking, sound-but-incomplete abstract interpretation, CEGAR/refinement, bounded/model checking, probabilistic/property testing, and explicit abstention. — ✅ `gmi-833-af5-verification-barriers-v1` `guarantee_lattice` is the powerset of 8 atoms ordered by subset with `total_ranking: false`, and every category the row names is a registered named point: `DECIDABLE_RESTRICTED_FRAGMENT`, `SEMI_DECISION_BUG_WITNESS`, `CERTIFIABLE`, `SOUND_INCOMPLETE_APPROXIMATION`, `CEGAR_REFINED_CERTIFIABLE`, `BOUNDED_MODEL_CHECKED`, `PROBABILISTIC_PROPERTY_TEST`, `UNKNOWN_ABSTAIN`, plus `UNRESTRICTED_UNDECIDABLE` as the empty guarantee set.
- [x] Prove/measure which contract changes move which finite fixtures from `UNDECIDABLE/UNKNOWN` to `CERTIFIABLE/SOUND_APPROX/PROBABILISTIC`. — ✅ `gmi-833-af5-verification-barriers-v1` measured on the frozen fixtures: the same `safe` system `s0->s1->s2` moves `UNKNOWN_ABSTAIN` (semidecision, `safe_proved: false`) to `CERTIFIABLE` under the inductive invariant `{s0,s1,s2}` (proof_construct 3 / proof_check 6) and from `UNKNOWN_FALSE_ALARM_POSSIBLE` to `SOUND_INCOMPLETE_APPROXIMATION` after one CEGAR refinement (`spurious_counterexamples: 1`), while BMC on the 4-step bug system moves `NO_BUG_FOUND_WITHIN_BOUND` at k=3 to `BUG_WITNESS_WITHIN_BOUND` at k=4; the `PROBABILISTIC_PROPERTY_TEST` point is reached on a separate frozen 8-bit promise (four ones, three distinct samples) at exact `delta = 1/14`, not on the `s0-s2` fixture.
- [x] Require soundness/completeness/termination tradeoffs to be explicit; never launder false positives, false negatives or nontermination. — ✅ `gmi-833-af5-verification-barriers-v1` each fixture receipt carries the tradeoff as a field rather than as prose — `sound: true` / `complete: false` on both abstractions, `unbounded_safety_proved: false` on both BMC bounds, `safe_proved: false` on both semidecisions, `exact_decider: false` on the property test — and each laundering route is a registered forbidden promotion: `FALSE_ALARM_IS_BUG`, `BOUNDED_NO_BUG_IS_UNBOUNDED_PROOF`, `PROPERTY_TEST_IS_EXACT_DECIDER`, `SOUND_AND_COMPLETE_AUTOMATIC_VERIFICATION_UNIVERSAL`.
- [x] Include certificate-producing machines in the candidate intelligence space and charge proof construction/checking resources separately. — ✅ `gmi-833-af5-verification-barriers-v1` `CERTIFICATE_EMITTER` is a candidate in the selection space alongside `DIRECT_REPLAY`, with raw vector `(base 5, direct_verification 0, proof_construct 5, proof_check 1)` keeping construction and checking as separate coordinates (the `safe` fixture's own certificate costs 3 to construct and 6 to check), and `CERTIFICATE_CONSTRUCTION_FREE` is a forbidden promotion.
- [x] Test whether architecture/morphology changes when verification cost becomes a protected resource coordinate. — ✅ `gmi-833-af5-verification-barriers-v1` an exact-rational crossover under the preregistered diagnostic `base + w_v * verification_burden`: argmin is `DIRECT_REPLAY` at `w_v=1/10` (19/5 against 28/5), a two-way tie at `w_v=1` (11 against 11) and `CERTIFICATE_EMITTER` at `w_v=2` (17 against 19); the executor hard-fails with `SELECTION_CROSSOVER_DRIFT` if that pattern moves, and `UNIVERSAL_VERIFICATION_MORPHOLOGY` is forbidden so no architecture law is promoted from the fixture.

---

### AF6 — Search, complexity and learnability barriers as movable surfaces

- [ ] Reconstruct the sharpened NFL premises exactly (including permutation-closure/distribution conditions) and prove that structured/non-permutation-invariant ecologies are outside that NFL symmetry regime rather than saying `NFL is false`.
- [ ] Derive what ecology information/prior is required for a search advantage and charge its acquisition/encoding cost.
- [ ] Import Blum speedup correctly: some computable functions lack a single asymptotically optimal implementation under the relevant complexity-measure conditions; distinguish this from finite-budget Pareto selection and proof-restricted speedup results.
- [ ] Add worst-case vs average/smoothed/parameterized complexity as barrier axes; test transitions where the general problem remains hard but a structured parameter regime becomes tractable.
- [x] Use the 2026 list-language-identification result as a modern discriminating case: changing the output contract from one exact hypothesis to a bounded list can change identifiability. Do not claim this defeats Gold under the old contract. — ✅ `gmi-833-af-barrier-context-v1` the 2026 result is pinned as a parent (Charikar, Pabbaraju & Tewari, COLT/PMLR 336 (2026)) and instantiated as transition record `F7_LIST_OUTPUT`: LANGUAGE_IDENTIFICATION under POSITIVE_TEXT moves from `NOT_IDENTIFIABLE_AT_SCOPE` to `IDENTIFIABLE_IN_LIMIT` with the only changed axis `V` (SINGLE_ANSWER_OUTPUT -> FINITE_LIST_OUTPUT), nearest residual barrier 'single-answer identification is not thereby established'.
- [ ] Add information-augmentation cases where traces/annotations/active queries change learnability and log the supplied information channel.
- [ ] Parent-map interactive learnability to DEC/information-ratio/sample-complexity work rather than inventing a new generic sample-complexity law.

---

### AF7 — Physical substrate / hypercomputation audit

The original mathematical Church-Turing thesis concerns effective computation; stronger claims about all physically realizable computation are separate empirical theses. GMI must leave a substrate slot open rather than assuming physical Turing maximality by definition.

### Scientific interpretation

The target is not to worship impossibility theorems and not to hand-wave them away. The target is to turn them into **mapped boundary conditions**. A valid GMI result should be able to say both:

```text
under premises A: capability/property X is impossible or undecidable;
under the minimal registered change B: X becomes decidable/learnable/certifiable/approximately usable,
at explicit information/resource/substrate cost C;
and residual boundary D remains.
```

That makes barrier displacement itself part of the theory of developing machine intelligence.
